brief.text: Log in and Sign up for It's a Date in one file: 'Welcome back' and 'Create your account' cards on cream, side by side on desktop and stacked on phone, each linking to the other, logged-out header; States board behind a 'Show design states' toggle with wrong password, email taken, field validation, busy, network error and the ?next hint 'Log in to share your idea'.
assumptions: Log in and Sign up only: no forgot password, magic link or code screens (spec section 4)
Logged-out header: Log in / Sign up instead of the avatar menu
Copy that exists in apps/web/src/features/auth is binding
States board is design-only, in a closed details toggle under the page
Email and password only, no social sign-in (the API has none)

findings.fix: Remove padding-inline: 8px from the live .site-nav phone rule so it keeps var(--gutter) of 16px. Change .nav-actions gap from 4px to 2px and give the ghost 'Log in' button padding 0 6px under 400px, keeping each target at least 44px tall.
findings.problem: The phone header uses padding-inline: 8px, so the wordmark sits about 8px from the edge while the cards below start at the 16px gutter.

findings.fix: While the password error shows, hide the helper and point aria-describedby at the error only. Bring the helper back once the value has 8 or more characters.
findings.where: states board, frame 3 'Field checks', Sign up password field
findings.problem: The error 'Use at least 8 characters.' and the helper 'At least 8 characters.' sit stacked under the same field, saying the same rule twice.

findings.fix: Put 'Log in instead' on its own line under the error message at 14px weight 600 in coral ink, with padding 4px 0 so its tap area is at least 24px tall. Keep the error message at 12px danger.
findings.where: states board, frame 2 'Email already has an account', 'Log in instead' link (phone)
findings.problem: The main way out of this error is a 12px inline link about 16px tall that wraps onto its own line on a phone.

findings.fix: Resolve it where it belongs: Home's avatar menu 'Your ideas' links to profile once the profile screen is designed.
